# Default Recolor
Simple Blue Default Recolor Texture Pack for Sword PvP (you may use this for other gamemodes but it's mainly focused for Sword PvP! the only things modified are the diamond items.

# Modpack
Use my [Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/sodiumpvp) with the texutre pack so you won't have to use Overlays such as Low Fire, Low Shield etc. 

# Updates
Join my [Discord](https://discord.gg/xGXRc2cXmK) server for updates, new releases & new recolors!

you can use the items I recolored in your texture packs or add things to this texture pack it's up to you. it's literally just a recolor of the default items :D however, giving credits such as adding this link:
https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/default-blue is appreciated!
